verdict.rationale: EDD's published e-Services for Business enrollment uses an email verification link, then offers text message or phone call as an additional login verification method, with email as a fallback. All of these are credential-based MFA steps an authorized human can complete remotely. Nothing in the pack points to biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN sent by physical mail. missing for 10: an explicit statement that no identity-proofing step (such as a mailed PIN or third-party ID verification) is required, hands-on corroboration of the login flow (the eddservices portal returned 403 to the probe), and detail on the recurring sign-in versus one-time enrollment.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: Select Text Message or Phone Call to set up an additional login verification method or select use my email instead.
Select the verification link in the email we sent you to complete the enrollment process.
